verdict.rationale: Expensify documents building rules by asking its AI ("build rules... by just asking") and several event-driven automations: auto-submitting reports on a timeline, auto-exporting finalized reports to QuickBooks Online, policy-based auto-categorization, and automated approval and reimbursement flows. However, the evidence never shows a general user-configurable rule engine with explicit event triggers, conditions and actions; most automations are fixed product behaviors. Missing for 10: documentation of user-defined trigger/condition/action rule configuration, a range of supported events and actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration that user-built rules fire reliably.
